_comment: Which strings from the UI table are POPUPS the player reads, listed by a distinctive substring. A list rather than a rule, because shape cannot tell them apart: the table holds skill tooltips ('Main component used to calculate the chance to hit with ranged weapons.'), store errors and a developer placeholder in exactly the same form as the tutorials. Tooltips especially must never be voiced - they fire on mouseover, so a voice would talk over the whole character sheet. The popup names in Assembly-CSharp (OpenPopupSpend, OpenPopupEtiquette, OpenPopupTotem, OpenPopupIntro, OpenPopupMageVision) are what this list was checked against.
